title: Final Force Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the force F must be correctly derived and presented as F = (Qqr)/(2πε₀R²γ²)e_r.

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria: The application of Gauss' law to find the electric field E' within the beam must be correctly utilized.

title: Transformation of Fields
description: Important Criteria: The transformation of electric and magnetic fields from the rest frame to the laboratory frame must be correctly applied.

title: Inclusion of Velocity Factor
description: Important Criteria: The factor involving the velocity v and its relation to the Lorentz factor γ must be correctly included in the final force expression.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of the final expression for force should be checked for consistency.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the force expression, particularly in the terms involving v²/c².

title: Limiting Case Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The limiting case where v << c should be correctly analyzed and compared to the stationary case.
